question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **RENOUNCE**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Renounce"** means to formally give up or abandon something, such as a right, claim, or possession. (त्यागना)
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to renounce his inheritance and donate it to charity.
 
 
• **"Reject"** means to refuse to accept, agree to, or consider something. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She rejected the job offer because it didn't align with her career goals.
 
 
• Both "Renounce" and "Reject" share similar meanings in the context of refusing or giving up something, making "Reject" the most appropriate synonym for "Renounce."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adopt** (अपनाना): To take up or start to use or follow something, such as an idea, method, or behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** They adopted a new strategy to improve sales.
 
 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): To consent to receive or agree to something.
 
 
• **Example:** He accepted the invitation to the wedding graciously.
 
 
• **Welcome** (स्वागत करना): To greet someone or something in a friendly and positive manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The host welcomed all the guests warmly.
